ops.newText: to enable the Software to operated within the Corio Servers' hosted environment ("DEVELOPMENTS"), shall be owned by Corio, including

ops.text: 13.5.1 Commerce One grants Corio a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to any Commerce One intellectual property embedded in the deliverables, including the Developments. Corio retains all rights in all data provided by or on behalf of Corio or its Customers. There shall be no joint ownership of any deliverables, Developments or any enhancements, modifications or derivative works developed under this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted only the carve-out that reverts ownership of Corio-created Developments to Commerce One where it supports them, so ownership stays with us as Section 13.5 already provides. We have also added a short clause giving us a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any Commerce One IP embedded in the deliverables, confirming our rights in our data, and barring joint ownership, consistent with our IP position.
proposal.summary: Delete the vendor ownership carve-out in Section 13.5 and add an embedded-IP licence, Corio data rights, and a no-joint-ownership statement.
